inputs.query: Social media impact on mental health

sources.title: Social media and depression
sources.content: Study of 5000 adolescents found 30% increased depression risk with >3 hours daily social media use.

sources.title: Social media benefits
sources.content: Social media provides social support for isolated individuals and reduces loneliness.

contradictions.description: Source 1 focuses on negative effects while Source 2 identifies positive effects - context-dependent outcomes
